mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posting (company, position, direction, content, display_content, audit_status, submitter_id, submitter_ip, submitter_role) VALUES (#{company}, #{position}, #{direction}, #{content}, #{displayContent}, #{auditStatus}, #{submitterId}, #{submitterIp}, #{submitterRole})
mapper.select: SELECT id, company, position, direction, content, display_content, audit_status, submitter_id, submitter_ip, submitter_role, reject_reason, create_time FROM job_posting WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, company, position, direction, content, display_content, audit_status, submitter_id, submitter_ip, submitter_role, reject_reason, create_time FROM job_posting WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, company, position, direction, audit_status, create_time FROM job_posting WHERE company = #{company} AND position = #{position}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_posting WHERE company = #{company} AND position = #{position}
SELECT DISTINCT direction FROM job_posting WHERE audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND direction IS NOT NULL ORDER BY direction
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_posting WHERE audit_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET audit_status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE job_posting SET position = #{position}, direction = #{direction}, display_content = #{displayContent} WHERE id = #{id}
